description: Clone shared Wanderlog plans into editable trips, then mine guides and places for agent-ready planning.

novel_features.name: Shared plan clone
novel_features.description: Create a new Wanderlog trip from a shared or public source plan, then fill it with the source plan template.

novel_features.name: Existing trip fill from template
novel_features.description: Fill an existing Wanderlog trip from a shared or public source plan with dry-run and force safeguards.

novel_features.name: Clone preview and copyability report
novel_features.description: Inspect a shared plan and report dates, sections, blocks, resources, and clone warnings before any write.

novel_features.name: Trip key discovery
novel_features.description: List the authenticated account's home trips together with their 16-character plan `key`s. Also: list my trips, own itineraries.

novel_features.name: Slim itinerary outline
novel_features.description: Show a slim itinerary outline: days, section headings, and stop names, optionally for a single day. Also: show days in my plan, slim day list.

novel_features.name: Itinerary consistency checks
novel_features.description: Inspect a slim itinerary outline and, with `--check`, report counts, unformatted notes, lodging coverage, closed places, and text-vs-schedule mismatches. Also: verify an itinerary after edits.

novel_features.name: Plan vote counts
novel_features.description: List place and hotel block upvote counts for a Wanderlog plan. Also: who upvoted places, upvotedBy counts.

novel_features.name: Lodging candidate search
novel_features.description: Search Wanderlog's lodging aggregator across Airbnb, Expedia, Google, and Kayak for a geo and date range, and return compact candidates carrying price, rating, coordinates, and booking URL. Also: search hotels, find a place to stay, compare stays.

novel_features.name: Section index listing
novel_features.description: List editable section indexes, day numbers, section ids, dates, and block counts for a plan.

novel_features.name: Note blocks
novel_features.description: Add a note block to a selected day or section through ShareDB.

novel_features.name: Place blocks
novel_features.description: Add a real place block to a selected day or section from a Google/Wanderlog place id, or from a query with location bias. Also: geocode a place by query, verify an address.

novel_features.name: Place swap in place
novel_features.description: Replace only the nested place on an existing itinerary block, keeping its times and notes.

novel_features.name: Batch day fill
novel_features.description: Insert a batch of place stops into one Wanderlog day from a JSON array of stops with optional times and notes.

novel_features.name: Block move
novel_features.description: Move a note or place block within or across days.

novel_features.name: Block delete
novel_features.description: Delete a note or place block from a selected day or section.

novel_features.name: Rich-text note editing
novel_features.description: Replace the rich-text note attached to an existing block, as plain text or compiled markdown with `--markdown`. Also: replace a stop note as plain text.

novel_features.name: Markdown note formatting
novel_features.description: Compile a markdown note into Wanderlog rich text: **bold**, `-`/`*` bullets, and `#` label lines. Also: format notes with bullets, bold text, rich text on a stop.

novel_features.name: Block display rename
novel_features.description: Rename the display name on an existing place or lodging block. Also: rename a place or hotel, change a display name.

novel_features.name: Arbitrary block fields
novel_features.description: Set or remove a non-protected field on a block, including newly observed fields from live plan data.

novel_features.name: Block scheduling
novel_features.description: Set or clear first-class schedule fields on an existing block. Also: set stop times, duration.

novel_features.name: Block attachments
novel_features.description: List, add, or remove attachment metadata on a block. Also: tickets, booking links, PDFs.

novel_features.name: Reservation blocks
novel_features.description: Add a flight, lodging, rental car, restaurant, transit, cruise, or standalone attachment block with dates, times, and confirmation details. Also: record a hotel stay, check-in and check-out dates.

novel_features.name: Checklists
novel_features.description: Add checklist blocks and add, check, or remove checklist items. Also: packing lists, todo items.

novel_features.name: Plan comments
novel_features.description: List, add, edit, delete, or vote on Wanderlog plan comments using the confirmed comments API. Also: friend discussion, replies, comment votes.

novel_features.name: Collaborators and sharing
novel_features.description: Inspect collaborator/share metadata, list pending invites, send email/user invites, add or remove collaborators by user id, and create share keys. Also: invite a friend, share links, share keys, pending invites, permissions.

novel_features.name: Trip budget
novel_features.description: Summarize, export, and edit Wanderlog trip budget expenses and settlement payments. Also: add an expense, costs, splits, payers, record a payment or settlement, CSV export.

novel_features.name: Route optimization
novel_features.description: Build route optimization request bodies or call Wanderlog's optimizeRoute endpoint. Also: optimize a route, better travel order.

novel_features.name: Edit journal with undo/redo
novel_features.description: List, preview, undo, and redo local-journaled ShareDB itinerary edits (`plan history`, `plan undo`, `plan redo`). Also: undo my last edit, redo my last edit, revert an itinerary change.

novel_features.name: Add a day
novel_features.description: Insert a new day section and update trip day/date bounds.

novel_features.name: Section fields
novel_features.description: Set or remove a field on a section, including day headings or rich text.

novel_features.name: Section delete
novel_features.description: Delete an empty section and update trip day/date bounds.

novel_features.name: Day swap
novel_features.description: Swap the block arrays of two day sections in one JSON0 batch.

novel_features.name: JSON0 batch apply
novel_features.description: Preview or apply a JSON0 operation array read from disk with --ops-file. Also: apply an ops-file batch of plan edits.

novel_features.name: Raw JSON0 escape hatch
novel_features.description: Preview or apply an explicit ShareDB JSON0 operation array.
